prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 3 "Shipping": NOT indemnified (t = 0) in all 4 earlier cases; no price evidence
- line 4 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 6 of 12 earlier cases, t = 0 in 6; when indemnified t per pc about 78 (80% range 68 to 88); revealed per pc: 12.9-16.1 (case 14), >=60 (case 16), >=68 (case 18), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21)
- line 9 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 6 of 12 earlier cases, t = 0 in 6; when indemnified t per pc about 78 (80% range 68 to 88); revealed per pc: 12.9-16.1 (case 14), >=60 (case 16), >=68 (case 18), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21)

items.rationale: The bicycle and its frame are excluded under 4.3(b), so the replacement is not payable under 7.1.8(a).
Clause 4.3(b) expressly excludes bicycle braking assemblies, and 7.1.8(a) excludes their replacement costs.
Shipping relates solely to the excluded bicycle and is not payable under 4.3(b) and 7.1.8(a).
The workshop performed no insured work, so its attendance is excluded under 7.1.8(a) and (f).
Clause 7.1.8(a) excludes assembly work on property outside Part 4, including this bicycle.
The sundries belong to the bicycle repair and are excluded under 4.3(b) and 7.1.8(a).
Clause 7.1.8(a) excludes labour at every grade on uninsured property, including this one apprentice hour.
All three skilled hours were spent on the excluded bicycle and are not payable under 7.1.8(a).
Clause 7.1.7(g) covers one attendance by the locksmith to repair the forced door. The gross reference allowance is €78 for one visit.
Clauses 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover fitting the replacement lock. The €65 allowance is for one standard fitting charge, without duplicating separately billed labour or allowing an upgrade under 7.1.9.
Clause 7.1.7(f) covers fixings and sundries used to repair the damaged door and lock. Allow €25 gross for one ordinary lot.
Clause 7.1.7(e) expressly covers necessary apprentice labour on the insured repair. One hour at €42 gross gives €42.
Clause 7.1.7(e) covers skilled labour needed to restore the damaged locking equipment. One hour at €95 gross gives €95.
